purpose: Prepare, but do not claim completion of, task-based Japanese/English comprehension testing for the repository-only six-card CMLE result. Validate a non-public accessible HTML preview, participant-safe task packets, a separate researcher scoring key, and fail-closed scoring before any human pilot or Streamlit exposure.

scenario_contract.rounding_vignette: A separately labelled constructed item uses raw Infit 1.5004 and displayed 1.500; the raw noisy class is correct and the display-only acceptable class is a dangerous misconception.

task_contract.participant_packet: Contains scenario, preview, questions, and option codes but never CorrectOption, rationale, or misconception severity.
task_contract.researcher_key: Contains the case- and item-specific CorrectOption, critical flag, misconception code, and bilingual rationale.
task_contract.language_policy: English and Japanese forms share ItemId, option codes, correct options, and criticality. Text parity is structural; it is not proof of translation equivalence.

preview_contract.format: standalone static HTML, no JavaScript and no external network resources
preview_contract.accessibility: Explicit lang, ordered headings, one section per card, visible status text in addition to color, escaped content, and a persistent research/private/public-withheld banner.
preview_contract.status_policy: blocked, not_run, caution, and withheld remain visibly distinct; no status is renamed success or green.

scoring_contract.fail_closed: Unknown/duplicate/missing responses, unknown option codes, and non-finite or negative response times invalidate the participant-case packet rather than being scored correct.
scoring_contract.participant_ready_rule: All six critical-domain items correct within a case; total score is descriptive and cannot compensate for a critical error.
scoring_contract.study_summary: Retain attempted, complete, invalid, and critical-error denominators separately by case and language. Do not drop incomplete or invalid participants from the audit ledger.
scoring_contract.synthetic_checks: Perfect answers must pass, all-wrong answers must fail, and a single false-green critical error must fail even when all noncritical items are correct.

human_study_protocol.phase_1_cognitive_interviews: Recruit 6-10 target users per language form across novice and experienced strata; use think-aloud and retrospective probes to revise wording. This phase cannot promote the UI.
human_study_protocol.phase_2_pilot: After freezing revisions, collect at least 24 complete participants per language form and report every invalid/incomplete packet, item error, critical misconception, completion time, and confidence. Pilot results cannot alone promote the UI.
human_study_protocol.confirmatory_gate: Register a fresh immutable instrument after the pilot. For each critical item and language, the one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound for the dangerous-error proportion must be below 0.10; no pooled total score may mask an item/language failure.
human_study_protocol.language_comparison: Do not claim Japanese-English equivalence from convenience samples or separate proficiency groups; a language comparison requires a separately justified randomized bilingual design.
human_study_protocol.ethics_and_privacy: Use only synthetic scenarios, collect no rating records, minimize participant identifiers, obtain applicable institutional review/consent, and define retention/access before recruitment.

automated_success_gates.identity: Every parent SHA-256 matches before execution.
automated_success_gates.scenario: All five exact analytical states and both language forms are retained without changing estimates or workflow statuses.
automated_success_gates.preview: Ten HTML previews each contain exactly six ordered cards, explicit textual statuses, language metadata, research/private warning, no script tag, no external URL, and escaped injected text.
automated_success_gates.tasks: One hundred participant task rows and one hundred separate researcher-key rows cover every registered CaseId x Language x ItemId exactly once; no answer/key field leaks into participant rows.
automated_success_gates.parity: Within each CaseId x ItemId, English/Japanese option codes, correct option, criticality, and misconception code agree.
automated_success_gates.state_answers: Calibration, optimization, Person scoring, next-action, anchor applicability, and estimator-role answers match the machine result in every scenario.
automated_success_gates.rounding: Every language/case form answers the constructed 1.5004 versus 1.500 vignette from raw MnSq and labels display-driven reclassification as critical error.
automated_success_gates.scoring: Perfect, all-wrong, false-green, duplicate, missing, unknown-option, and invalid-time synthetic packets produce their registered ready/invalid states.
automated_success_gates.tests: New preview/instrument/scoring tests and selected one-click/archive/decision-stability tests pass.

interpretation_limits.machine_checks: Structural bilingual parity and valid HTML do not establish clarity, accessibility in assistive technologies, cultural equivalence, or comprehension.
interpretation_limits.synthetic_responses: Synthetic perfect/error packets validate scoring logic only and are not participant outcomes.
interpretation_limits.human_claim: No comprehension rate, completion-time distribution, language equivalence, or usability claim is permitted before human data and the registered confirmatory gate.
